entities.summary: Danuta Kordaczuk-Wagner was a Polish volleyball player and head coach, a member of Poland women's national volleyball team in 1956–1970, a bronze medalist of the Olympic Games Tokyo 1964, a bronze medalist of the World Championship and medalist of the European Championship.
